rules.title: IIoT + DataOps ABI conflict risk
rules.rationale: A repository mixing IIoT drivers such as pymodbus with Python data analytics libraries such as pandas can create silent dependency or ABI conflicts. The industrial driver and the data layer often have different stability requirements and should not unnecessarily share one dependency space.

checks.message: IIoT driver detected — check environment isolation

rules.fix:
Use separate venv/conda environments for the IIoT drivers and the data
layer. Each part should have its own requirements file.
rules.full_text:
Rule: IIoT + DataOps ABI conflict risk
ID: cross-001
Profile: cross
Severity: error
Why it matters: A repository mixing IIoT drivers such as pymodbus with Python data analytics libraries such as pandas can create silent dependency or ABI conflicts. The industrial driver and the data layer often have different stability requirements and should not unnecessarily share one dependency space.

How to fix: Use separate venv/conda environments for the IIoT drivers and the data
layer. Each part should have its own requirements file.

References: Practical DataOps, Designing Data-Intensive Applications

rules.title: IIoT control plane exposed via web API
rules.rationale: When web application and IIoT components coexist, PLC commands must not be reachable through unauthenticated API routes. The IT/OT boundary is a safety boundary, not only a security boundary.

checks.message: Web API route references PLC — verify authentication

rules.fix:
API routes that reach the PLC must require authentication.
Use network segmentation (DMZ) between the OT and IT networks.
rules.full_text:
Rule: IIoT control plane exposed via web API
ID: cross-002
Profile: cross
Severity: warning
Why it matters: When web application and IIoT components coexist, PLC commands must not be reachable through unauthenticated API routes. The IT/OT boundary is a safety boundary, not only a security boundary.

How to fix: API routes that reach the PLC must require authentication.
Use network segmentation (DMZ) between the OT and IT networks.

References: Industrial Network Security, IEC 62443

rules.title: Hardcoded secret in pipeline code
rules.rationale: A hardcoded password, token, or API key committed to source control stays exposed in Git history even after removal. Secrets belong in the runtime environment or a secret manager, never in the codebase. This violates the security undercurrent of the data engineering lifecycle and DataOps governance practices.

checks.message: Hardcoded secret or credential detected. Use environment variables or a secret store.

rules.fix:
Move the secret to an environment variable or a secret manager.
Add the real secret file to .gitignore and rotate the exposed credential.
rules.full_text:
Rule: Hardcoded secret in pipeline code
ID: dataops-sec-001
Profile: dataops
Severity: critical
Why it matters: A hardcoded password, token, or API key committed to source control stays exposed in Git history even after removal. Secrets belong in the runtime environment or a secret manager, never in the codebase. This violates the security undercurrent of the data engineering lifecycle and DataOps governance practices.

How to fix: Move the secret to an environment variable or a secret manager.
Add the real secret file to .gitignore and rotate the exposed credential.

References: Practical DataOps, Fundamentals of Data Engineering

rules.title: Database password embedded in connection string
rules.rationale: An unencrypted connection URI with an embedded password exposes credentials in code, logs, and version history. Connection secrets must be injected at runtime, not baked into pipeline configuration.

checks.message: Unencrypted connection string with embedded password detected.

rules.fix:
Replace the embedded password with an environment variable reference, e.g.
postgres://user:${DB_PASSWORD}@host/db, and load DB_PASSWORD from a secret
manager at runtime.
rules.full_text:
Rule: Database password embedded in connection string
ID: dataops-sec-002
Profile: dataops
Severity: critical
Why it matters: An unencrypted connection URI with an embedded password exposes credentials in code, logs, and version history. Connection secrets must be injected at runtime, not baked into pipeline configuration.

How to fix: Replace the embedded password with an environment variable reference, e.g.
postgres://user:${DB_PASSWORD}@host/db, and load DB_PASSWORD from a secret
manager at runtime.

References: Designing Data-Intensive Applications

rules.fix:

Pulumi, or Kubernetes manifests, and commit the definitions to the repository.

Pulumi, or Kubernetes manifests, and commit the definitions to the repository.

rules.title: Hardcoded relation reference in dbt model
rules.rationale: Hardcoded database.schema.table paths break environment portability and prevent dbt from building the DAG required for correct execution order and lineage. Models must reference relations through ref() and source().

checks.message: Hardcoded three-part relation reference found in dbt model. Use ref() or source().

references.book: Analytics Engineering with SQL and dbt
references.concept: explicit dbt lineage via ref and source

rules.full_text:
Rule: Hardcoded relation reference in dbt model
ID: dataops-dbt-001
Profile: dataops
Severity: error
Why it matters: Hardcoded database.schema.table paths break environment portability and prevent dbt from building the DAG required for correct execution order and lineage. Models must reference relations through ref() and source().

How to fix: Replace hardcoded FROM/JOIN targets with dbt Jinja references:
- internal dbt models: {{ ref('model_name') }}
- raw source tables: {{ source('source_name', 'table_name') }}

rules.title: Missing dbt_project.yml root manifest
rules.rationale: A repository containing dbt models without dbt_project.yml cannot be parsed or executed by the dbt CLI or CI tooling. The root manifest is the required entry point that identifies a directory as a dbt project.

checks.message: dbt_project.yml is missing from the repository root.

rules.fix:
Initialize the dbt project with `dbt init` or ensure dbt_project.yml is
committed at the repository root with name, version, and profile defined.

references.book: Analytics Engineering with SQL and dbt

committed at the repository root with name, version, and profile defined.

checks.message: models/ directory is missing from the dbt repository.

rules.fix:
Create the models/ directory at the repository root and organize SQL
transformations into staging/, intermediate/, and marts/ subfolders.

rules.rationale: Using custom macros or third-party package macros without a packages.yml manifest causes compilation failures in CI/CD. Package dependencies must be declared explicitly for reproducible macro resolution.

checks.message: packages.yml manifest missing while a macros/ directory is present.

rules.fix:
Create a packages.yml file at the project root and declare all required dbt
packages with explicit version pins, then run `dbt deps`.

rules.title: No automated data quality tests detected
rules.rationale: A data pipeline without automated quality assertions can silently pass corrupted data downstream. Data quality must be enforced through version- controlled tests or an assertion framework at every transformation stage.

checks.message: No data quality test configuration or assertion framework detected.

rules.fix:
Add dbt generic tests (unique, not_null) to schema YAML files, or configure
Great Expectations / Soda for pipeline validation.

Profile: dataops
Severity: error

How to fix: Add dbt generic tests (unique, not_null) to schema YAML files, or configure
Great Expectations / Soda for pipeline validation.

rules.rationale: Standardized incident response documentation reduces mean time to resolution and removes reliance on tribal knowledge during data outages. Data incident management requires documented response and escalation paths.

checks.message: Repository lacks a version-controlled incident runbook.

rules.fix:
Create a RUNBOOK.md or docs/runbooks/ directory describing detection,
response, and postmortem workflows for data incidents.

rules.rationale: Data software without unit or integration tests cannot be validated during CI, so regressions reach production unnoticed. Practical DataOps treats automated testing as a core continuous-integration practice.

checks.message: Automated testing directory missing. Data software must include version-controlled test suites.

rules.fix:
Add a tests/ directory with pytest unit and integration tests, and wire them
into the CI pipeline.

rules.rationale: Time-based cron scripts or manual pipeline execution violate the DataOps undercurrent. Orchestration must be declared as version-controlled pipelines-as-code so workflows are reproducible and auditable.

checks.message: No pipeline orchestration code found. Declare workflows as code (DAGs).

rules.fix:
Define data pipelines as code using Apache Airflow (dags/*.py), Dagster, or
Prefect, and commit them to version control.

rules.title: Missing dependency lockfile
rules.rationale: Without a lockfile, dependency versions drift between environments, causing silent breakage and non-reproducible pipeline runs. Environment parity is a core DataOps requirement.

checks.message: Dependency lockfile missing. Pin package versions for reproducible pipeline execution.

rules.fix:
Generate a lockfile with `poetry lock`, `pip freeze > requirements.txt`, or
`conda-lock -f environment.yml`, and commit it.

Profile: dataops
Severity: warning

How to fix: Generate a lockfile with `poetry lock`, `pip freeze > requirements.txt`, or
`conda-lock -f environment.yml`, and commit it.

rules.title: No schema IDL for streaming events
rules.rationale: Streaming pipelines without an explicit schema definition language are vulnerable to unannounced breaking changes. Schema evolution must be managed through versioned IDL files so producers and consumers stay compatible.

checks.message: Streaming schema IDL definitions missing. Use explicit schema files (Avro/Protobuf) for event streams.

rules.fix:
Define event schemas with Avro (.avsc) or Protobuf (.proto) in a schemas/
directory and enforce compatibility checks in CI.
rules.full_text:

ID: dataops-kleppmann-002
Profile: dataops
Severity: error

How to fix: Define event schemas with Avro (.avsc) or Protobuf (.proto) in a schemas/
directory and enforce compatibility checks in CI.

rules.title: No database migration tooling detected
rules.rationale: Schema changes applied by hand are error-prone and not auditable. Database schema evolution should be managed by version-controlled migration scripts so changes are repeatable and reversible.

checks.message: Database schema migration directory missing. Version-control schema DDL evolution.

rules.fix:
Adopt a migration tool such as Alembic or Flyway and store all schema DDL
changes under a migrations/ directory.

rules.title: Fact model joins on natural key instead of surrogate key
rules.rationale: Joining fact models directly on natural operational codes couples the warehouse to source-system keys and breaks when those codes change. Kimball dimensional modeling requires surrogate keys for dimensional joins.

checks.message: Fact table model joins on a natural operational key. Use warehouse surrogate keys (_sk) for dimensional joins.

rules.fix:
Generate surrogate keys for dimensions and join facts to dimensions on the
surrogate key column (e.g. customer_sk) instead of the natural key.
rules.full_text:
Rule: Fact model joins on natural key instead of surrogate key
ID: dataops-kimball-001
Profile: dataops
Severity: error
Why it matters: Joining fact models directly on natural operational codes couples the warehouse to source-system keys and breaks when those codes change. Kimball dimensional modeling requires surrogate keys for dimensional joins.

How to fix: Generate surrogate keys for dimensions and join facts to dimensions on the
surrogate key column (e.g. customer_sk) instead of the natural key.

References: The Data Warehouse Toolkit

rules.title: SCD Type 2 dimension lacks effective-date tracking
rules.rationale: A slowly changing dimension that does not track effective dates cannot preserve history or answer point-in-time queries. SCD Type 2 models require valid-from/valid-to tracking columns.

checks.message: SCD Type 2 dimension model lacks required effective-date tracking columns.

rules.fix:
Add effective_at / valid_from / valid_to columns to the dimension model to
track historical state, or use dbt snapshot to manage SCD Type 2.
rules.full_text:

Severity: error

How to fix: Add effective_at / valid_from / valid_to columns to the dimension model to
track historical state, or use dbt snapshot to manage SCD Type 2.

dimensions and commit it under docs/.

columns are automatically redacted for non-privileged roles.

rules.title: Missing Modbus error handler

No Modbus mock/simulator found for testing

rules.fix:
Wrap Modbus reads in try/except for ModbusIOException.
Use pymodbus.device.ModbusSimulatorServer as the test mock.
